quarterly_data.signal: NEW INSTINCT DEMAND POCKET OUTSIDE THE DATA CENTER: Jack Huynh (SVP & GM, Computing & Graphics) launched the Threadripper Halo Station, 'the most powerful workstation in the world', capable of running AI models with 'more than 1 trillion parameters'. Configuration disclosed on stage: '96 cores on Threadripper PRO, two MI350P Instinct accelerators with the path to four. Up to 2 terabytes of system memory and up to 576 gigabytes of HBM 3E. All liquid cooled.' This puts MI350-class Instinct silicon and HBM3E content into a workstation SKU — a liquid-cooled, HBM-bearing product line that did not exist in AMD's data-center-only Instinct framing on the Q2 call.
quarterly_data.figure: Threadripper Halo Station: 96 cores on Threadripper PRO, two MI350P Instinct accelerators with the path to four, up to 2 terabytes of system memory, up to 576 gigabytes of HBM 3E, all liquid cooled; runs models with more than 1 trillion parameters
